sloka: तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि तिर्यक् योनि गतानि अपि ।प्रियम् कुर्वन्ति रामस्य त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् यथा वयम् ॥४-५६-१०॥
transliteration: tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni tiryak yoni gatāni api ।priyam kurvanti rāmasya tyaktvā prāṇān yathā vayam ॥4-56-10॥

translations.english: In that way all creatures, even those born as animals, do what is dear to Rama by risking their lives, just as we do.
